content.short: CoinRaces is a crypto prediction game where players back the strongest coin in short market-driven 3D races.
content.description: CoinRaces is a prediction game that turns groups of cryptocurrencies into short 3D races. Players choose which coin they expect to perform best during each round, with race outcomes tied to live market moves instead of random selection. The official product positions CoinRaces as a competitive, easy to follow experience that can be distributed through partner platforms and Telegram friendly flows, which helps place it inside the broader TON gaming ecosystem as a repeatable social play format for casual and returning players.
content.meta: CoinRaces turns live crypto price moves into short prediction races. Explore CoinRaces and other TON games on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
